data_output.description: The fixed training command must write predictions_valid.npz containing exactly two arrays: row_ids, an int64 sequence matching canonical validation row order, and scores, a finite one-dimensional float32 score array with identical length and no additional arrays. Ground truth must not be written or loaded by training.

model_input.description: The model receives the training-fitted encoded feature matrix in supplied row order: four training-vocabulary categorical IDs for user_id, video_id, tab, and weekday, followed by hour_sin and hour_cos float32 cyclic features. Validation uses the same training vocabularies and preserves canonical validation row order.
